judge.rationale: The candidate fails to follow almost all specific naming and behavioral requirements in the ticket. It invents its own message and interface names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `conversations`). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, `StoreCannotList`, and the documentation updates in `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`. Furthermore, it violates explicit ticket constraints by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is unimplemented instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error, by accepting `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of enforcing 1–200, and by leaving an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the repository.
